title: Earning Rewards with Your Cobalt Blue Debit Card
summary: Explains how to earn rewards with the Cobalt Blue debit card: you earn 1.0% cashback on eligible purchases. Rewards accrue as purchases settle, are calculated on the net purchase amount after returns/adjustments, and are reversed if a purchase is reversed or refunded.
faqs: What is the cashback/rewards rate for eligible Cobalt Blue debit card purchases?
When do rewards accrue and post (settlement vs authorization)?
How is cashback calculated if I return or have adjustments to a purchase?
What happens to rewards if a purchase is reversed or refunded?
How many Cobalt Blue debit cards can I request for team members?
Where can I track earned, pending, and posted rewards and filter by vendor categories?
keywords: net purchase amount after returns or adjustments
category filters (vendor where debit is accepted)
team debit cards (up to 6 business debit cards)
